caption: The drawing shows a single vintage iron placed centrally within a rectangular border on a plain light background. The iron is depicted in shades of brown and black, with a dark handle attached to the main body by two curved metal supports. The main body of the iron is triangular in shape and features a row of jagged, serrated edges along its base. There is also a small, protruding pointed component at the front. Fine detailing and shading provide a three-dimensional effect, making the metallic texture and wooden handle distinct. The artist’s signature and a numerical annotation appear in small text at the bottom right corner inside the bordered area.
title: Fluting Iron
